# GridOne
> GridOne is a football squares app for Super Bowl squares, fundraisers, office pools, watch parties, and community groups.

GridOne helps organizers build and share a digital football squares board with one live viewer link, organizer-only editing, and live winner/scenario tracking.

## Notes
- GridOne is organizer-first.
- Everyone can follow a published board from one link; only the organizer can change it.
- The first published board is free each season.
- Game Day is $9.99 once for up to 5 published boards in the 2026 season.
- Organization is $79 per season for up to 50 published boards plus organization naming, one dashboard, and one organization receipt.
